message.content: All 34 tests pass and the build compiles cleanly. Let me do a final verification against all the requirements:

function.arguments:
{"thought": "
Let me verify every requirement systematically:

**Employee Model** ✅
- All exact fields present: id, employeeNumber, firstName, lastName, email, managerId (string|null), department (string|null), hireDate (Date), terminationDate (Date|null), employmentStatus (EmploymentStatus), createdAt, updatedAt, deletedAt (Date|null)
- Imports EmploymentStatus from shared/types

**Employee Repository** ✅
- IEmployeeRepository extends IBaseRepository<Employee> with findByEmployeeNumber, findByEmail, findByManagerId, findActive
- EmployeeRepository extends BaseRepository<Employee>, table 'employees'
- All queries filter deleted_at IS NULL

**Employee Service** ✅
- IEmployeeService with getById, getByEmployeeNumber, getByEmail, getSubordinates, isActive
- getById throws NotFoundError (never returns null)
- isActive throws NotFoundError for nonexistent employee

**LeavePolicy Model** ✅
- All exact fields: id, policyName, leaveType (LeaveType), entitlementDays, accrualRate (number|null), maxAccumulation (number|null), minimumNoticeDays (number|null), requiresManagerApproval, isActive, createdAt, updatedAt
- Imports LeaveType from shared/types

**LeavePolicy Repository** ✅
- ILeavePolicyRepository extends IBaseRepository<LeavePolicy> with findByLeaveType, findActive
- LeavePolicyRepository extends BaseRepository<LeavePolicy>, table 'leave_policies'

**LeavePolicy Service** ✅
- ILeavePolicyService with getById, getByLeaveType, getActivePolicies, isLeaveTypeActive
- getById and getByLeaveType throw NotFoundError
- isLeaveTypeActive returns false for nonexistent policy (never throws)

**Barrel exports** ✅ - Both index.ts files export model, repository interfaces/classes, service interfaces/classes

**Tests** ✅ - Both spec files exist with comprehensive coverage, all 34 tests pass

**Constraints** ✅
- no-any: No `any` types used
- no-direct-db-outside-repository: All DB access through repository pattern
- no-hardcoded-secrets: No secrets
- no-gestalt-internal-deps: No @gestalt/* packages

**Module boundaries** ✅ - All imports go through barrel/index files, no circular deps

**Build & Tests** ✅ - tsc --noEmit passes, all 34 tests pass
"}
